scripts._comment:test:emulator: Firestore-backed repository tests ONLY. Kept out of `test` so the fast suite stays emulator-free: those tests compile to lib/emulator/, which the `lib/*.test.js` glob does not recurse into. Java: the Firestore emulator needs a JRE. The script uses whatever `java` is already on PATH (e.g. a CI runner's setup-java, or a system JDK); homebrew's JDK dir is prepended ONLY as a local fallback, and only when that directory actually exists — macOS ships a stub `java` shim that cannot run the emulator, so on this Mac the homebrew JDK (`brew install openjdk`) wins. On Linux/CI the homebrew dir is absent and the PATH java is used unchanged. If your JDK lives somewhere else, put it on PATH before invoking this script. The project id is the reserved `demo-` prefix, which makes the tooling offline-only and unable to reach a real Firebase project. firebase.json binds the emulator to 127.0.0.1:8080; if `localhost` resolves to ::1 on your machine, swap FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST to 127.0.0.1:8080.
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && sh -c 'if [ -d /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin ]; then PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH"; export PATH; fi; exec firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --only firestore --project demo-monthly-story "FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:8080 node --test lib/emulator/*.test.js"'
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
